While the Senevita locations stand for independent assisted living and comprehensive care, Senevita Casa is the leading provider of private Spitex services throughout Switzerland. • Management and maintenance of internal documents, files and databases
• Contact person for all administrative inquiries and requests within the office
• Professional administration of the calendar and appointment management of the CFO
• Organization, preparation and follow-up of meetings as well as management and management meetings
• Management of correspondence and central contact for internal and external stakeholders.
• Creation of presentations, reports and other basis for decision-making Support for strategic projects as well as coordination between the finance teams, management and external partners
